requirements.title: Functional AI Substrate (Real Model & Backend Provisioning)
requirements.description: models install resolves and fetches the REAL weight asset(s) per model + backend file layout, validates the downloaded artifact (type/magic/size, not just self-checksum), and pins an upstream-verified checksum. A backend-program provisioning/detection path exists (or CPU defaults are provisionable pure-Go/ONNX). The selector reports runnable-vs-declared honestly, and at least one AI op runs end-to-end on CPU from the CLI and UI. Closes the validate-first gap (PROBLEMS 2026-06-18: the prior install path fetched landing pages, not weights).

validation.notes: Installer rejects non-weight artifacts (HTML / wrong type / oversize); pins an upstream-verified checksum after artifact validation
Attended host gate: one AI op (background_removal / upscale) runs end-to-end on CPU and produces a real output image
